# nesting.toml: snippets that nest others: the questions they bring, and where Aralo stops
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== a snippet goes in where another one names it
--- en_US
field: "Hi there, thanks.|"
preview: "Hi there, thanks."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi there, thanks.|"
preview: "Hi there, thanks."
undo: 17 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi there, thanks.|"
preview: "Hi there, thanks."
undo: 17 backspaces

=== a nested body brings its own questions to the outer form
--- en_US
field: "Hi Dana,\nsee you Tuesday.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\n."
undo: 25 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi Dana,\nsee you Tuesday.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\n."
undo: 25 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi Dana,\nsee you Tuesday.|"
preview: "Hi friend,\n."
undo: 25 backspaces

=== a nested date reads the same clock and locale
--- en_US
field: "sent 9 March at 14:05|"
preview: "sent 9 March at 14:05"
undo: 21 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "sent 9 März at 14:05|"
preview: "sent 9 März at 14:05"
undo: 20 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "sent 9 3月 at 14:05|"
preview: "sent 9 3月 at 14:05"
undo: 18 backspaces

=== a snippet that reaches itself is left as written
--- en_US
field: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b|"
preview: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b"
undo: 25 backspaces
error: "Case reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."
--- de_DE
field: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b|"
preview: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b"
undo: 25 backspaces
error: "Case reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b|"
preview: "a a {{snippet: Case}} b b"
undo: 25 backspaces
error: "Case reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."

=== two snippets that reach each other stop at the second turn
--- en_US
field: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>|"
preview: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>"
undo: 21 backspaces
error: "Mirror reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."
--- de_DE
field: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>|"
preview: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>"
undo: 21 backspaces
error: "Mirror reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>|"
preview: "<{{snippet: Mirror}}>"
undo: 21 backspaces
error: "Mirror reaches this snippet again, so it is left as written."

=== a reference to no snippet says so and stays
--- en_US
field: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}"
undo: 24 backspaces
error: "No snippet in the library answers to nowhere."
--- de_DE
field: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}"
undo: 24 backspaces
error: "No snippet in the library answers to nowhere."
--- ja_JP
field: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet: nowhere}}"
undo: 24 backspaces
error: "No snippet in the library answers to nowhere."

=== a reference with no name at all
--- en_US
field: "see {{snippet}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet}}"
undo: 15 backspaces
error: "Write {{snippet: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."
--- de_DE
field: "see {{snippet}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet}}"
undo: 15 backspaces
error: "Write {{snippet: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."
--- ja_JP
field: "see {{snippet}}|"
preview: "see {{snippet}}"
undo: 15 backspaces
error: "Write {{snippet: a-name}}: without a name there is no answer to put in."

=== nesting stops at the depth limit
--- en_US
field: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}|"
preview: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}"
undo: 23 backspaces
error: "Snippets are nested 8 deep before s9, which is as far as Aralo goes."
--- de_DE
field: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}|"
preview: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}"
undo: 23 backspaces
error: "Snippets are nested 8 deep before s9, which is as far as Aralo goes."
--- ja_JP
field: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}|"
preview: "12345678{{snippet: s9}}"
undo: 23 backspaces
error: "Snippets are nested 8 deep before s9, which is as far as Aralo goes."
